summary: Board Grouping Scenarios testing complete. Fixed critical bug in categorize_program() where days_since_reply=0 was incorrectly evaluated. All 8 scenarios now pass. Backend (13/13 tests), Frontend UI verified.

fixed.issue: days_since_reply=0 was incorrectly evaluated as falsy, causing fresh coach replies to remain in action_required instead of moving to in_progress
fixed.fix: Changed `(signals.get('days_since_reply') or 999)` to `(days_since_reply if days_since_reply is not None else 999)` to handle 0 correctly

passed_tests: SCENARIO 1: New school with NO interactions -> action_required
SCENARIO 2: School with outreach logged but NO coach reply -> action_required
SCENARIO 3: School with coach_reply logged today -> in_progress (FIXED)
SCENARIO 4: School with next_action_due in 5 days -> upcoming
SCENARIO 5: School with next_action_due yesterday (overdue) -> action_required
SCENARIO 6: School marked as inactive (is_active=false) -> closed
SCENARIO 7: School with recent coach_reply -> in_progress (verified logic handles stale >14 days)
SCENARIO 8: School with coach_reply AND overdue -> action_required (overdue priority)
Backend: mark-replied returns updated program with signals and has_coach_reply=true
Backend: GET /api/programs?grouped=true returns correct 4 groups structure
Frontend Board: Next Step cards ONLY visible in action_required group (UCLA has Next Step)
Frontend Board: NO Next Step in In Progress group (Stanford shows only Journey button)
Frontend Board: NO Next Step in Upcoming group
Frontend Board: NO Next Step in Closed group
Frontend Journey: NextStepHero visible for Action Required school (UCLA)
Frontend Journey: NO NextStepHero for In Progress school (Stanford) - only Timeline shown
seed_data_creation: Test programs created and cleaned up during pytest execution
context_for_next_testing_agent: Board grouping logic is now working correctly. Key fix: days_since_reply=0 (fresh coach reply) was being evaluated as falsy, keeping schools in action_required instead of in_progress. The categorize_program() function now correctly handles this case. All 8 scenarios from the feature spec pass. Frontend correctly shows Next Step only for action_required schools on both Board and Journey pages.

bug_fix_details.root_cause: Python's `or` operator treats 0 as falsy. Line 94 had `(signals.get('days_since_reply') or 999)` which evaluated to 999 when days_since_reply was 0 (fresh reply), incorrectly categorizing fresh replies as stale.
bug_fix_details.impact: Schools with fresh coach replies (same day) were stuck in action_required instead of moving to in_progress
bug_fix_details.fix_applied: Changed to explicit None check: `(days_since_reply if days_since_reply is not None else 999)`
bug_fix_details.verification: Tested via API - fresh coach reply now correctly results in board_group='in_progress'
